title: Chapter 278: Everyone Burrows Underground To Avoid Danger
content:
Chapter 278: Everyone Burrows Underground To Avoid Danger

It was a giant chariot pulled by a group of snow-white war horses.

The giant chariot was a fully enclosed box structure, which made people know at a glance that it was a chariot used for combat, but there were no weapons installed outside the car, and no people driving or guarding.

The Zerg host, which had broken the rule-level shielding power of the alien race, could not sense the situation in the car.

The car of this mysterious chariot had another layer of powerful rule-level shielding power!

Around the chariot, there were tens of thousands of alien mages, and the strong magic energy fluctuations were caused by their spells.

"Tens of thousands of powerful human mages?!"

"No! This is a trick! Most of the mages are not strong!"

"But the Zerg host can't tell the difference between them!"

"Is this the power of the mysterious chariot?"

Wu Qing saw tens of thousands of powerful alien mages, and even the five-star Zerg host couldn't tell whether they were real or fake. He knew that this time the Zerg army would have to eat several large-scale battlefield magics of the aliens!

The powerful alien mages, their status in the aliens is similar to that of the Zerg Queen in the Zerg.

The Zerg Queen, a special type of soldier, is extremely powerful, but it also consumes a lot of resources. The number of high-star Zerg Queens is destined not to be too large.

It is difficult to train a powerful human mage in the aliens, and it is impossible to send such a large number of powerful mages at once.

The Zerg Queen controls some of the powerful alien mages. Through them, Wu Qing has some understanding of the situation of the alien mages.

So he knew that among the tens of thousands of alien mages, there were not many human mages with five-star or above strength, but because of some factors, even the Zerg host could not tell their strength.

This should be the means used by the aliens to deal with the Zerg queens, which is very targeted.

There are only a thousand Zerg queens, and it is indeed a bit troublesome to deal with tens of thousands of alien mages who can't distinguish the real from the fake.

Moreover, the distance is a bit far, and the Zerg queen can't attack the target unless she flies forward for a distance.

Fortunately, the large-scale battlefield magic performed by the alien mages seems to be limited by distance.

The mysterious chariot, pulled by a group of white horses, drove from the alien space transmission channel area to the direction of the Zerg main battle force.

Tens of thousands of alien mages, riding white war horses, gathered around the mysterious chariot.

The armies in the 996th city of the alien race, which had been waiting in silence, began to move rapidly in large numbers towards the main battle formation of the Zerg.

The alien race seemed to be organizing a large-scale attack.

Wu Qing ordered the air force, mainly the Zerg flying dragon, to fly away from the sky above the main battle formation of the Zerg and began to circle around the battlefield.

The air forces of the alien race were all on standby in the city and did not take off. The sky now allowed the Zerg air forces to fly.

The Zerg puppies around the main battle formation of the Zerg all burrowed into the ground to avoid the upcoming large-scale battlefield magic.

The main battle formation of the Zerg was the main attack target of the alien army. The main battle forces of the Zerg did not move for the time being, and the Zerg destroyers continued their attacks.

Amid the sound of the Zerg destroyers' artillery fire, the large-scale battlefield magic prepared by the powerful mages of the alien race became more and more terrifying.

As the mysterious carriage approached, the magic fluctuations became stronger and stronger, and it seemed that something terrible would happen in the next second.

A transport host flew over, picked up Wu Qing's Zerg clone and Zerg guards, and flew away from the main Zerg combat unit.

The observers from various forces in the local camp also quickly moved away from the battlefield. They also sensed the huge threat.

"Did the aliens use their clan's heritage? This is really within the scope of the rules, and they are using everything to the extreme!"

"I don't know what they took out! The Zerg has no way to deal with the aliens' powerful battlefield magic!"

"Why didn't the Zerg fight back this time? If they don't do it now, it will be too late!"

"It should be that the aliens have found an effective way to deal with the Zerg's counterattack. The other Zerg armies have avoided the main attack targets of the aliens. It seems that the Zerg is ready to face the large-scale battlefield magic head-on!"

"The complete large-scale battlefield magic of the aliens is very terrifying, and now the Zerg seems to be facing an enhanced version!"

"I hope the Zerg can survive this!"

"What other means does the Zerg have? It's time to use them!"

"..."

Most of the observers from various forces in the local camp have not discovered the changes in the depth of the aliens' Jiujiulix City, and have not seen the mysterious chariot and tens of thousands of alien wizards.

For safety, they have to stay away from the battlefield, which makes it even more difficult to discover the real situation.

The Zerg Queen flew a few circles with the Zerg Dragons, turned to a suitable attack distance, and immediately launched a random spawning attack on the tens of thousands of alien mages surrounding the mysterious carriage.

Five hundred five-star Zerg Queens and five hundred three-star Zerg Queens launched spawning attacks at the same time, and a thousand alien mages immediately stopped casting spells and fell into a confrontation with the self-destructing parasites in their bodies.

No matter how many stars their real strength is, five hundred of them will die as long as they are not seven stars.

As long as the remaining five hundred people can survive without dying, they can prove that they are five-star or six-star strength.

It's a pity that the Zerg Queen's attack has little impact on the large-scale battlefield magic that the powerful human mage has launched.

Five hundred three-star Zerg queens, surrounded by Zerg flying dragons, immediately pupated and were about to be upgraded to four stars.

However, the five hundred three-star Zerg queens have not yet been upgraded, and the powerful human mage from outside the world has followed the mysterious chariot to the predetermined attack distance.

Extremely strong fluctuations of magical energy rushed into the sky above the Zerg main battle formation. The rules of heaven and earth in the area where the Zerg main battle formation was located seemed to have been changed. The clear sky instantly turned black, and twinkling stars appeared.

"This is an enhanced version of Stars Falling! Retreat! Everyone, retreat further!"

Some observers shouted.

Wu Qing experienced the enhanced version of the falling stars battlefield magic through the Zerg host. He sensed the powerful magical power contained in this battlefield magic.

If this battlefield magic is allowed to completely fall into the main formation of the Zerg main battle units, all the one-star Zerg main battle units will definitely be lost!

If the continuous attack time of this battlefield magic is longer, the Zerg main battle unit with two-star strength will hardly be spared!

Perhaps only the Zerg main combat arms with three-star and above strength could survive such an attack.

Wu Qing looked at the tens of thousands of outer human mages and the mysterious chariot, and immediately ordered all the Zerg main combat units to go deep underground to avoid attacks.

"I hope there will be more six-star experts this time!"

All Zerg ground troops have the ability to burrow into the ground.

Originally, Wu Qing only exposed the ability of the Zerg puppies and Zerg stealth spiders to burrow into the ground. Now, in order to avoid the powerful battlefield magic attacks of the outsiders, the secret of the Zerg ground troops being able to burrow underground is now known to everyone.

Faced with the current situation, even if the insect queen immediately takes action to destroy the group of powerful human mages from outside the world, it will not be able to stop the enhanced version of the stars falling battlefield magic.

Letting all ground troops go underground is the best response. Otherwise, the Zerg main combat arms will suffer a devastating blow.

Nearly two million Zerg main battle ground troops received Wu Qing's order and immediately drilled deep underground.

Those Zerg saboteurs who had just stopped attacking were no exception. Their huge bodies were as flexible as a big insect. They burrowed deep into the ground in one go, and the hole outside was automatically blocked. It looked seamless!

Burrowing into the ground is the innate magical power of the Zerg, and it is also a manifestation of rule-level power. When it comes to the rules of the world, there is no reason to say it, it just works!

"All the Zerg troops have gone underground!"

"Those huge bodies are so flexible when they burrow into the ground! Burrowing into the ground must be the innate magical power of the Zerg!"

"Unexpectedly, all Zerg have the ability to burrow into the ground!"

"This should be able to minimize the losses!"

"If they weren't forced into a hurry, the Zerg's ability wouldn't have been revealed! It would be too easy to fight an ambush!"

"..."

As everyone sighed, the enhanced version of Star Fall was fully activated. Star-like shining energy balls fell to the ground, and intensive explosions purified and annihilated all matter on the ground!

Countless energy balls continued to fall, blasting dense holes into the ground.

However, this kind of energy with the attribute of purification and annihilation does almost no damage to non-contact substances. This allows the nearly two million Zerg ground battle units that have all burrowed into the ground to suffer no harm at all.

This is the advantage brought by information asymmetry. No one knows that all Zerg can burrow into the ground, which allows the Zerg army to avoid a major crisis.

If the Terrans knew that all the Zerg main battle units could burrow into the ground, then they would definitely not use the battlefield magic of Stars Falling.

The commanders of the Tianwai Human Race army were very decisive. When they discovered that the Stars Falling had done nothing, they immediately ordered the troops in the Tianwai Human Race's 996 City to rush out of the city wall and rush towards the phalanx of the Zerg's main battle force.

Those powerful human mages who had suffered some losses due to the Zerg Queen's attack began to prepare for a large-scale magic.

Five hundred were upgraded to four-star Zerg Destroyers and regained the ability to spawn attacks. They immediately used spawning attacks to attack a small number of five-star alien human mages that had been identified, and the remaining attack targets were randomly selected.
